modmenu.summaryTranslation.lava_boat_clu: Doth mend the lava boat clutch mechanic, methinks
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lava_boat:
Restoreth the lava boat clutch mechanic that wast mended in 1.21.5.

Upon first contact with the molten rock, the vessel receiveth a brief immunity, so the player may land upon its hitbox.

Now canst thou perform lava clutches like Dream, but in newer versions!
config.lava_boat_clutch.title: Lava Boat Clutch Fix Settings
config.lava_boat_clutch.enable_mod.toolt: Doth enable or disable the lava boat clutch mechanic.
config.lava_boat_clutch.immunity_ticks.t: The number of ticks in which the vessel doth not burn in the molten rock.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_mode:
Default: doth use vanilla velocity
Custom: doth use configurable velocity.
Random: doth use random velocity.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_y.to: Upward velocity applied to the vessel's drop after it doth burn in the molten rock.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_x.to: Lateral velocity along the X axis applied to the vessel's drop after it doth burn in the molten rock.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_z.to: Lateral velocity along the Z axis applied to the vessel's drop after it doth burn in the molten rock.
